lines.text: The LORD, the God of Israel, gave Jeremiah a word for Baruch son of Neriah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim.
Baruch said the LORD had added sorrow to his pain, and he was worn out with groaning.
Baruch said that he was worn out with groaning and had found no strength.
The LORD said He would demolish what He had built and uproot what He had planted throughout the land.
The LORD told Baruch to stop seeking great things for himself, and promised that wherever he went, he would keep his land.
